bad_request.title: That didn’t go through
bad_request.message: Some of the information could not be used. Please check it and try again.

unauthorized.title: Please sign in again
unauthorized.message: Your session has ended. Sign in to continue where you left off.

forbidden.title: You don’t have access to this
forbidden.message: Ask the owner for access, or return to your trips.

not_found.title: We couldn’t find that
not_found.message: It may have been removed or the link may be out of date.

conflict.title: This changed in the meantime
conflict.message: Someone — or something — updated this after you opened it.

rate_limited.title: Too many requests
rate_limited.message: Please wait a moment before trying again.

server.title: Something went wrong on our side
server.message: This is not your fault. Please try again shortly.

bad_gateway.title: A service didn’t respond correctly
bad_gateway.message: Please try again in a moment.

unavailable.title: TravIndi is briefly unavailable
unavailable.message: We are working on it. Your saved information is still here.

gateway_timeout.title: That took too long
gateway_timeout.message: The service did not answer in time. Please try again.

network.title: You seem to be offline
network.message: Check your connection. Anything saved on this device is still available.

timeout.title: That took too long
timeout.message: Your connection may be slow. Please try again.

unauthorized.title: Email or password is incorrect
unauthorized.message: Check your details and try again.

validation.title: We couldn’t build this journey yet
validation.message: A few trip details are missing or conflict with each other. Review them and try again.

unavailable.title: The journey planner is busy
unavailable.message: Your trip details are saved. Try generating again in a moment.

conflict.title: Your itinerary changed while you were away
conflict.message: Review the latest version before applying your change.

not_found.title: This stop is no longer available
not_found.message: We couldn’t update your itinerary because this place is no longer available.

conflict.title: This update is out of date
conflict.message: Your itinerary changed after this suggestion was made. Nothing was applied.

not_found.title: This suggestion has expired
not_found.message: Nothing was changed. Your current plan still stands.

network.title: Saved on this device
network.message: Your alert will be sent as soon as you reconnect. If you are in immediate danger, call 112.

network.title: Not sent
network.message: You appear to be offline. Try sending again when connected.

forbidden.title: You can’t post here
forbidden.message: You may no longer be a member of this conversation.

conflict.title: Availability changed
conflict.message: This option was taken while you were reviewing it. Nothing was charged.

forbidden.title: Sharing isn’t allowed here
forbidden.message: You can’t share location with this group.

network.title: Search needs a connection
network.message: Saved trips and places are still available offline.
